metadata.title: New Wave Portrait with Geometric Framing

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition featuring a central square studio portrait framed by black horizontal bars at the top and bottom, separated by thin neon pink horizontal rules. The central image depicts a man with 80s-style blonde hair being pointed at by a hand gesture from off-frame, set against a textured blue architectural background.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand gesture creates a horizontal vector pointing directly at the subject's forehead.
The neon pink horizontal lines act as high-contrast dividers between the image and the black text fields.
The subject's pinstripe pattern contrasts with the soft, mottled texture of the background columns.
The wide tracking of the typography mirrors the horizontal expanse of the frame.
coreInvariants: Cool-toned blue and purple lighting in the central frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right third of the frame; an arm enters from the left edge reaching toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the pointing finger at the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, drop to the arm on the left, follow the finger to the subject's face, and finish at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the black bars and the dark blue background between the arm and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black in the framing bars and cobalt blue in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon pink for the dividing lines and text highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender-purple for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value neon accents against low-value dark backgrounds; skin tones are pale and desaturated.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'S' has a wide, horizontal curve
The 'G' is circular with a short crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic color variation within the same extended typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 80s tech-geometric aesthetic and wide proportions.
Provides the necessary square-off curves and horizontal weight.
Similar geometric structure though slightly more angular.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square image of a man with a blonde 80s mullet wearing a pinstripe blazer, looking at a hand pointing a finger-gun at him. Background is a textured blue stone column. Place this square between two thick black horizontal bars, separated by thin neon pink lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in an extended geometric sans-serif font to the top and bottom black bars. Use lavender for the top text and neon pink for the bottom text. Apply extreme tracking so the words span the full width.

verificationChecks: Are the pink lines perfectly horizontal and thin?
Is the text tracking wide enough to reach the margins?
Is the lighting on the subject cool-toned (blue/purple)?
Does the typography use an extended geometric skeleton?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background texture
Specific hue of the lavender text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the image is divided into three distinct horizontal sections.
Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the pink lines do not bleed into the text or the central image.
Confirm the subject's hair has the characteristic 80s volume and texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square central portrait + Black letterbox bars + Neon rule dividers + Extended geometric sans-serif with wide tracking.
